mapper.sql: select audit_id, client_event_id, device_id, user_id, user_name, kind, source, event_type, host_id, host_name, session_id, command, risk, decision, exit_code, detail, occurred_at, create_time from itm_audit_command
mapper.insert:
insert ignore into itm_audit_command (client_event_id, device_id, user_id, user_name, kind, source, event_type, host_id, host_name, session_id, command, risk, decision, exit_code, detail, occurred_at, create_time) values
(#{i.clientEventId}, #{i.deviceId}, #{i.userId}, #{i.userName}, #{i.kind}, #{i.source}, #{i.eventType}, #{i.hostId}, #{i.hostName}, #{i.sessionId}, #{i.command}, #{i.risk}, #{i.decision}, #{i.exitCode}, #{i.detail}, #{i.occurredAt}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select client_event_id from itm_audit_command where device_id = #{deviceId} and client_event_id in #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from itm_audit_command where occurred_at < #{before} limit #{limit}
